note: Elements taken from the 12 landing-page samples. 'approved' elements are part of an approved landing page. 'variation' elements come from samples that were not chosen as a landing page, and are available as patterns for turns in any tab. A pattern may be used in another tab, but it is always redrawn in that tab's own look by that tab's generator (06 §1, 07 §9). Using one in a turn for the first time goes through review like any new block.

shared.name: Update stamp with Refresh now
shared.purpose: When the page was last brought up to date, what is not in yet, and a button to refresh now.
shared.reuse_in: Any page that summarises a changing state: landing pages, a weekly review turn, a trial check-in.

shared.name: Proceed, Add more, Jump
shared.purpose: The three next moves, always in the same order, with the primary one filled.
shared.reuse_in: The end of any overview or summary turn where the user chooses how to go on.

shared.name: What Tojo still has to do
shared.purpose: Open items, with the ones that wait on the user marked in dashed amber and a line saying what is needed.
shared.reuse_in: Findings, progress and plan turns that end with open points.

elements.name: Route walked
elements.purpose: The 11-stop route with walked, now and still-to-walk stops, a legend and a count.
elements.reuse_in: Any process walk-through: pharmacy returns, admissions, the discharge chain in a progress turn.

elements.name: Figures with their source
elements.purpose: Four figures in boxes whose border carries state, each with a source tag.
elements.reuse_in: A findings or data-back turn; a compact stat strip on a landing page.

elements.name: Pulse line of stages
elements.purpose: One pulse line where each beat is a stage done; stages to come are flat and dashed.
elements.reuse_in: Showing progress through any staged sequence in a clinical voice: the trial weeks, the conversation arc.

elements.name: What you told us, what is happening, why
elements.purpose: A three-step ladder from the account, to what really happens, to the cause.
elements.reuse_in: A diagnosis turn; the conceded-half step of a challenge turn.

elements.name: Readings
elements.purpose: Figures as a chart of readings: label, big value, source tag.
elements.reuse_in: A data-back turn, or a measures summary with few figures.

elements.name: Under the glass
elements.purpose: The headline claim inside a lens, with the stages as its rim and a numbered stage list.
elements.reuse_in: Any turn that names one finding and shows how far the checking has got.

elements.name: Evidence pinned
elements.purpose: Figures as pinned cards, 2 across, each with its source.
elements.reuse_in: Beside any claim, as the evidence for it.

elements.name: Drawing sheets
elements.purpose: Each option as a drawing sheet with its revision, status, where it came from and what it depends on; earlier revisions sit behind it.
elements.reuse_in: An overview of options in Solutions; a set of roles or automations, each with its open points.

elements.name: Iteration tracks
elements.purpose: Each solution on a track from idea to agreed, its latest revision and what changed, and dots for settled and open points.
elements.reuse_in: Any set of items moving through the same stages: automations to switched on, hires to started.

elements.name: Redrawn lately
elements.purpose: A dated log of what was redrawn, with the revision and what caused the change.
elements.reuse_in: A 'what changed since yesterday' turn in any tab.

elements.name: Register of solutions
elements.purpose: Every solution in one list: number, name, what it depends on, status and a settled bar.
elements.reuse_in: A compact list of everything on the table, with status.

elements.name: Switchboard
elements.purpose: Each automation as a switch on one wire, behind the main switch they all need, with counts by state.
elements.reuse_in: Showing what depends on one prerequisite: an IT link, an approval, a hire.

elements.name: Overnight arc
elements.purpose: Each item placed at the hour it runs on an arc from evening to next afternoon, with the gate they wait on and a key.
elements.reuse_in: Any schedule across a night: when work moves out of the morning.

elements.name: How far they have got
elements.purpose: A ladder of stages with how many items reached each, and what is holding them.
elements.reuse_in: A progress summary for any set of items through stages.

elements.name: Signal bars
elements.purpose: Each item with signal bars filled to its stage, when it runs, and its status.
elements.reuse_in: A readiness list: automations, trial wards, roles being filled.

elements.name: Ward board
elements.purpose: Changes, measures and roles in three columns of magnet strips, with the trial strip across the foot.
elements.reuse_in: Any three-part summary of how the work changes.

elements.name: Measure readouts
elements.purpose: Each measure as an instrument window: its starting number, or a dashed window if it starts in the trial.
elements.reuse_in: A scorecard summary; the measures part of a trial check-in.

elements.name: Change lane and seat plan
elements.purpose: Process changes on one lane, and roles as seats, filled or empty, with the cost.
elements.reuse_in: A team and role turn; a staffing plan beside the changes it serves.

elements.name: Plan, try, measure, adjust, spread
elements.purpose: The improvement loop with the current step marked.
elements.reuse_in: Showing where a trial sits, and what happens after it.

elements.name: Cards pinned to the loop
elements.purpose: One card per area, each saying at which step of the loop it matters.
elements.reuse_in: Beside the loop; a plan grouped by stage.
